name: mw-company-formation
description: Malawi company formation and registration research for the intended 2026 intake. Use this partial Guide to distinguish private, public, guarantee and foreign companies, prepare the statutory incorporation evidence, check shareholder counts and director requirements, reconcile no-par share consideration, and separate company reporting from taxpayer registration. It reads the original Companies Act gazette rather than assuming that a business-name certificate creates a company. It also preserves the tax-registration handoff, existing TIN controls and nonresident representative boundary. Commencement, later company-law amendments, prescribed forms, fees and authenticated registration remain unresolved. This draft prepares a review file and does not certify incorporation, current legal compliance or approval to transact.
